title: Local Temporal Contrasts on Human Motion Data Induce a Latent Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.21630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series such as recordings of human motion data often encode structure across multiple temporal scales, and when a latent state determining this sequence evolves, this structure needs to survive in the representation space for downstream use. Yet the currently prevalent attention-based encoders paired with sequence-level pooling have made single-vector, pointwise comparison the default mode of inference, discarding the trajectory a sequence traces through the representation space. We propose recovering this geometric structure directly, without relying on forecasting-based objectives, by training an encoder model (SemTAC) with a temporal-neighborhood contrastive loss: representations that satisfy local consistency everywhere must give rise to a coherent global structure, letting inference happen at temporal scales beyond those seen during training. translated_title: 人体运动数据上的局部时间对比诱导出一种潜在几何结构
translated_abstract: 诸如人体运动记录这样的时间序列往往在多个时间尺度上编码结构信息，当决定该序列的潜在状态发生演化时，这种结构需要在表示空间中得以保留，以便下游任务使用。然而，目前流行的基于注意力的编码器配合序列级池化的做法，使单向量、逐点式的比较成为默认的推理模式，从而丢弃了序列在表示空间中所描绘的轨迹。我们提出直接恢复这种几何结构，而不依赖于基于预测的目标函数，方法是通过时间邻域对比损失训练一个编码器模型（SemTAC）：处处满足局部一致性的表示必然会产生连贯的全局结构，从而使推理能够发生在超出训练时所见时间尺度的时间尺度上。我们在一个五步运动序列判别任务上将SemTAC与四个基线方法进行了评估……
tldr: 提出SemTAC编码器，通过时间邻域对比损失直接恢复人体运动序列在表示空间中的轨迹几何结构，使模型能够在训练时未见过的更长时间尺度上进行推理。
en_tdlr: SemTAC, an encoder trained with a temporal-neighborhood contrastive loss, directly recovers the latent trajectory geometry of human motion sequences in representation space, enabling inference at temporal scales beyond those seen during training.
